## Statement

Regex + AST traversal of the parsed bundle extracts >= 90% of API endpoints.

## Verification Criterion

Endpoint recall >= 90% against the labeled endpoint set.

## Experiment Notes

Combined string-literal scan with AST call-site analysis.

## Result

**Finding:** Endpoint recall reached 94% on the labeled set.

**Prototype / Proof:** `./tools/endpoint-extractor`
